when_to_use: Use when the operator wants the dark royal-blue Vantrilex CLI theme active in OpenCode.
verify_cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),os=require('os');const p=os.homedir()+'/.config/opencode/themes/vantrilex-blazar.json';const f=fs.existsSync(p)?p:'registry/themes/vantrilex-blazar.json';const t=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8'));if(!t.base||(!t.dark&&!t.light))throw new Error('not a V2 theme');console.log('vantrilex-blazar: V2 theme parses from '+f)"
